packageRules.description: Own modules are wired via replace directives, so version bumps are no-ops. Consumers of /v2 ignore the replace, so the ssvsigner pin is kept in sync by hand (scripts/ssvsigner_pin.sh)
ssv-spec is pinned to feature branches on purpose and bumped manually
go-bitfield (now github.com/OffchainLabs); bump together with the go-eth2-client fork
Held by replace directives in go.mod, so a require bump is a no-op and a replace bump breaks the pin; bump by hand
gddo is archived; to be removed rather than bumped
prysm moved to github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm, so a major bump under the old module path can't resolve; migrate by hand
Wide surface (eth, discovery, p2p); keep separate so it can be soaked alone
Signing and slashing protection; keep separate so it can be reviewed alone
Base-image refreshes only; Go version bumps are in the go toolchain group below
Raise Go patch releases separately from a pending minor; read during lookup, so it can't sit in a rule with matchUpdateTypes
Bump go.mod's toolchain line (what CI and releases build with) and the golang images together; version updates only, as a pending minor would drop digest refreshes from a shared branch
differ UI is a dev-only tool, not shipped
